scripts.check: npm run check:rust && npm run check:agent && npm run check:harness && npm run test:tooling && npm run check:contracts
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && node scripts/with-ghostty.mjs cargo clippy --locked --workspace --features newport-release/signing --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/with-ghostty.mjs cargo test --locked --workspace --features newport-release/signing
scripts.check:agent: cargo fmt --manifest-path tools/agent/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/agent/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path tools/agent/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.test:native: node scripts/with-ghostty.mjs cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/test-harness/Cargo.toml -- native
scripts.check:harness: cargo fmt --manifest-path tools/test-harness/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/test-harness/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path tools/test-harness/Cargo.toml --locked
